## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Belongs with HR component** — Shares employee, department, job models with base HR; central to payroll, work entries, attendance
- **Boundary code**: Contract state machine (draft→open→close/cancel) drives downstream payroll calculations and leave accrual
- **Multi-tenant**: Contracts are company-scoped; wizard `hr_departure_wizard.py` handles offboarding (in subdirectories)
- **Resource calendar sync**: Mismatch detection (`calendar_mismatch` field) helps catch configuration drift with resource allocation
